company.name: Spyne
company.shortDescription: Spyne is a Deep Tech startup helping businesses and marketplaces create and upgrade high-quality product images and videos at scale with AI.
company.description:
At Spyne, our mission is to revolutionize automotive retailing. Every year, 52 million cars are sold in the US, for a combined worth of $1700 billion, and, valuing the used-car market at $1000 billion. Our new-age, Generative AI-powered solutions are designed to transform the car visuals into premium studio visuals. Dealerships & marketplaces across the US & Europe are able to better engage their online visitors, driving greater customer showroom visits and eventually sales.

Spyne aims to expand into additional software segments within the automotive market, addressing specific needs of dealerships. By leveraging our go-to-market craft we plan to cover all aspects of the car dealership journey, from acquiring and appraising cars to listing, marketing, selling, and managing customer relationships.

Spyne aims to be the leading retail software provider in the automotive market and we are proud to be backed by top investors such as Accel Partners, Storm Ventures, and some of the leading SaaS and Consumer tech founders globally.
